documents.handbook.txt: Employees accrue 25 days of paid holiday per year. Unused holiday can be carried over up to 5 days into the next year. Sick leave is unlimited but requires a doctor's note after 3 consecutive days.
documents.office.txt: The Lisbon office is on the 4th floor of Rua Augusta 120. Visitors must sign in at reception. The office closes at 8pm on weekdays and is closed on weekends.
documents.expenses.txt: Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 40 euros per day. Taxis are reimbursed only when public transport is unavailable. Submit receipts within 30 days of the trip.
documents.security.txt: Laptops must use full-disk encryption. Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Report lost devices to security@example.com within one hour.
documents.onboarding.txt: New starters receive their laptop on day one. The buddy programme pairs each new hire with a colleague for their first three months.
